name: medicine ball step behind rotational throw
description: An explosive rotational throw that starts with a step behind. It builds power through the hips and trunk.
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall, holding a medicine ball at hip height.
Step your rear foot behind you and load your weight onto it.
Rotate your hips and torso toward the wall.
Throw the ball hard into the wall at chest height.
Catch it, reset, and switch sides after your set.
